Ana here. Release triage until the retro tonight - phone away until it's cleared. My food notes are current and exact; please follow them as written. Tonight is the checkout pod's sprint-retro dinner - Thursday cadence, working dinner. Standing team norm since 2024: the sprint's facilitator books the usual (the Kestrel back booth) and there is no venue bikeshedding - the venue debate ate three retros in 2024. The cart IS the pre-order: the kitchen stages the table from it, every plate and drink a line on the row of whoever is eating it. One cart on the pod card: the team-dinner line has $110.00 left this quarter, so the platform holds tonight's items subtotal to $110.00 - service and tip go on the card at the table, outside the cart. Marcus's side opens tonight's cart and closes it.

Tonight's pre-order locks 21 minutes after the cart opens - the cart view and the checkout preview both count the minutes left, and the platform rejects a confirm after the cutoff.
Group cart created on Nomi Ramen. Spending limit: $110.00 — set at creation and fixed for this cart. You are the cart creator; only you can check out. Others add items under their own name.
Added 1× Shoyu Ramen (for Ana) — cart subtotal $21.50 of $110.00 (ci-01).
Added 1× Spicy Miso Ramen (for Marcus) — cart subtotal $44.00 of $110.00 (ci-02).
